The '''''Scarlet Star''''' was a [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] in the service of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] around [[137 ABY]]. It had no set crew or owners and was instead assigned to various crews and mission team as necessary.

==History==
The ''Scarlet Star'' was used by [[Monia Gahan]] and [[Anj Dahl]] to leave the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]] and return to the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] prior to the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|attempted theft]] of the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']].
